data.body:
FINAL rebar-debug report and merge evidence

Problem: Gerrit 1764 patchset 1 failed all three Ubuntu cells after the immutable legacy-output repair, while macOS passed.

Proven root cause: the schema emitted one macOS-arm64 Pandoc binary SHA-256 and the installed gate treated it as platform-independent. Pandoc 3.6.1 is identical by version but packaged as macOS arm64 SHA-256 94ebf1efbce3561379e8f25de3efe5aeabee64dc36dd8e8b9e96cf05b4195c52 and Linux x86_64 SHA-256 4715627586c5d9c732e8f5a6b6bb9e27c4216a76a7729e043b24374dedf8a1f0. CI run 31773167187 observed the latter identically on Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 and failed only the whole-object hash comparison; macos-26-arm64 passed.

Proof: all three Ubuntu logs reported the same exact version and Linux hash, ruling out Python-version drift, flakiness, and output incompatibility. A local cross-platform simulation reproduced Linux rejection against schema v1. The reviewed contract requires both exact version and binary fingerprint, so version-only validation was not a legitimate repair.

Test: a held-out behavioral oracle was RED against schema v1 on the absent full map and simulated Linux gate. The first draft over-specified private field names; per the test-modification guard the repair was removed, the oracle was revised around observable gate behavior, and the revised form was re-proven RED before the repair was restored. It was then GREEN 7/7. Defect-seeding the old mechanism by selecting the generating platform instead of the current platform returned the Linux case to RED; restoration returned GREEN. Equivalent permanent regression coverage lives in tests/scripts/test_generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py and tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render_hardening.py.

Fix: schema v2 retains generating platform/fingerprint plus the complete darwin-arm64/linux-x86_64 fingerprint map. A stable platform/architecture key selects the exact supported hash. Unknown platform, version drift, incomplete/mutated maps, generating-binary mismatch, and installed-binary mismatch fail with diagnostics. Regeneration validates before conversion and retains both supported fingerprints.

Scope and safety: only the four reviewed ticket paths changed. No production/library behavior or dependency changed; no assertion was weakened. The 884 immutable outputs and conversion metadata are semantically unchanged, and every per-change hardening run still makes all 884 real production `_convert`/Pandoc calls. Fresh regeneration was byte-identical at 464,245 bytes, fixture SHA-256 332014eff0b8fdd4477bd0e02d452e16997dd7ef5dbf076803696f66ba539ff0. Focused suite was 74 passed in 55.65s including the held-out checks; pinned lint, typecheck, and the commit hook passed.

Siblings: no production parity surfaces exist; this is a test-fixture provenance contract. The broader per-unit root-discovery cost remains separately tracked by lyrical-integral-waterdogs. Residual risk: a future Pandoc pin/platform-package change intentionally requires updating the frozen map and regenerating; fixed-in-scope diagnostics make that fail closed rather than silently drift.

Replication and runtime: patchset 2 run 31775744037 passed every job. Ubuntu py3.11/3.12/3.13 were 11m35s/15m13s/14m25s; macOS was 29m14s. Workflow created 06:16:52Z and completed 06:47:23Z = 1,831s (30m31s). The prior failed run completed in about 29m59s, so this single end-to-end sample is 32s slower despite the deterministic paired local saving of 32.3766s and 884 eliminated subprocesses; run variance therefore overwhelms the expected effect and no CI wall-clock saving is claimed from this pair. The macOS job itself remains inside the 20-30 minute target at 29m14s. CI_RESULT={"run_id":"31775744037","status":"passed","duration":1831,"fixes_applied":["platform-keyed exact Pandoc provenance while retaining all 884 real product conversions"],"retry_count":0}.

Gerrit evidence: patchset 2 b9fd05e288031184cdf50f7f6aff816cd11cde54 earned LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments. Gerrit submitted change 1764 as rebased main commit 7c946bdf898dd75f0fe213af2c33ee9bed2a96b8 at 2026-08-14 06:47:45Z. Back-out is a Gerrit revert restoring the prior live-vs-live oracle.
